background.usage: Primary body background. Gives deep depth feel for floating glass components.

surface.usage: Secondary background sections, structured container headers, and panel blocks.

card_surface.usage: Glassmorphism cards, interactive grids, and layout containers. Uses overlay backdrop-filter borders.

text.usage: Primary headings, active states, highlighted keywords.

secondary_text.usage: Body text, captions, secondary description labels, wireframe lines.

accent.usage: Buttons, active indicators, interactive cursor trails, core UI outlines.

accent_glow.usage: Blur glows, lighting indicators, card shadow effects.

success.usage: Interactive live status, success alerts, metrics percentages.

primary_gradient.usage: Cinematic text gradient reveals, progress bars, active hover visual accents.

surface_glass_glow.formula: radial-gradient(800px circle at var(--x) var(--y), rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1), transparent 40%)
surface_glass_glow.usage: Interactive hover overlay that dynamically follows the cursor inside glass panels.

border_glass_stroke.usage: Borders of cards to emulate premium glass refraction.

accessibility_verification.contrast_bg_secondary_text: 4.8:1 (Passes AA for normal text, AAA for large)
accessibility_verification.contrast_bg_accent: 3.1:1 (Recommended to use only as background borders or on primary white surfaces)
accessibility_verification.color_safety: Uses color-coding paired with semantic icons to meet WCAG guidelines
